Preserve everything else as closely as possible: same elderly male face, white moustache and short white hair, tender farewell expression, head angle, gaze, exact pose with one hand in his trousers pocket, other hand at his side, tan trench coat, black turtleneck, dark trousers, same colors and lighting, original anime illustration linework, exact silhouette and character proportions, same position and scale within the canvas. Output a square transparent PNG, ideally the same 1280 by 1280 canvas as the source; keep genuine alpha transparency.
